def harbor_bed(x,z):
 bay=(z+2.5)/3.6;point=(z+2.5-5)/ (3.6*.65)
 shore=8+math.sin(z*.14)*2+math.sin(z*.37+.4)*.6+2.2*math.exp(-bay*bay)-.85*math.exp(-point*point)
 offset=x-shore
 if offset<0:
  d=-offset;return -.11*d-.013*d*d/(1+d*.025)
 t=max(0,min(1,(offset-2)/12));return min(offset*.2,.7)+t*t*(3-2*t)*(.2+math.sin(z*.21)*.16)
